title: CLI GhostPlay: deterministic rehearsal & safety harness for admin workflows
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a deterministic, replayable sandbox for admin CLI actions ("GhostPlay") that lets SREs and support engineers rehearse runbook steps against a virtualized state before executing against production. The system will: capture CLI command traces with normalized inputs, synthesize safe simulated side-effects, run divergence checks against expected telemetry, and surface autosuggested mitigations derived from historical incident traces. Goal: reduce mean time to safe remediation and prevent accidental destructive commands during on-call remediation.
acceptance_criteria: 1) CLI command capture integrated into opsctl and web console action logs; 2) Rehearsal environment can deterministically replay 95% of common admin flows without live infra side-effects; 3) Safety gates (dry-run, permission elevation checks, quarantine) enforced before any 'execute' with configurable policies; 4) Autosuggested next-step hints show top-3 historical remediations with confidence scores; 5) Audit log links to original trace, rehearsal result, and final execution action for full provenance.
design_decisions: 1) Use an agentless capture model that records normalized CLI input + environment fingerprint rather than full machine snapshots to minimize privacy concerns; 2) Synthesize side-effects via a sandbox state machine instead of full VM replays to keep resource cost low; 3) Telemetry-driven suggestion model will run offline in a job that maps traces -> resolution recipes and assigns confidence using logistic regression; 4) Enforce RBAC and KMS-wrapped secret redaction at capture time; 5) Provide an opt-in 'sticky rehearsal' mode for dedicated teams with higher-fidelity replay (longer retention, deeper state).
tasks:
- Integrate capture hook into opsctl v2 CLI (ENG-329176 PR)
- Implement sandbox state machine and simulation backend
- Build a deterministic event replayer and divergence detector
- Telemetry pipeline: ingestion -> feature extractor -> suggestion model trainer
- Console UI: rehearsal modal, diff view, and execution gating
- Audit and compliance: exportable provenance bundle and retention policy
- E2E tests with synthetic runbook corpus
- Security review and threat modeling
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: False confidence from autosuggest could encourage unsafe shortcuts. Mitigation: conservative thresholding, explicit confirmation steps, and telemetry-backed confidence display. Risk: Captured traces accidentally include secrets. Mitigation: redaction at capture, KMS + HSM policy, and retention limits. Risk: Sandbox diverges from production semantics. Mitigation: 'sticky rehearsal' option for teams to opt into higher-fidelity checks and periodic calibration jobs comparing rehearsal vs. production outcomes.
